theme: Minnesota black bears, seasonal foraging and winter dens: a curious scoop-pawed cub grows a powerful digging stance and a thick sheltering shoulder ruff. The adult protects its den with broad planted forepaws; its heavy fur arches over the nape without becoming a building, costume or armor.
habitat: Dense woodland edges and secluded northern forest dens.

sources.evidence: Black-bear anatomy, forest habitat, seasonal berries and nuts, and winter denning.
sources.fantasy_extension: All powers, anatomy changes and discovery scenes are original fiction.
